prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult American woman — the personification of New York — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in New York as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's New York with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a grand museum hall with marble statues at night
Season: high summer — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty.
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a sharp tuxedo jacket over a silk camisole with tailored trousers — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right index finger rests against her lips in a hush.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: 원본 PNG는 올리지 않는다. 원본의 SHA-256을 기록한다.

observations: 박물관 조각상과 밤 조명이 뒤로 흐려지고, 정면 얼굴과 입술에 올린 검지가 보인다.
턱시도 재킷과 캐미솔로 복장이 바뀌었으나 대표컷과 유사한 크리스털 귀걸이가 남았다.
qa.cause: 얼굴 가까운 프레이밍에서 참고 이미지의 귀걸이가 따른 것으로 보인다.

acceptance: 사용자 승인: 대표컷 2번 선택 후 검수하고 원격 main에 일반 반영.
